description: This file implements a server for the ttrpc protocol, including server setup, connection handling, request processing, and shutdown procedures.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: Represents a ttrpc server managing connections, services, and listeners.

classes.name: serverConn
classes.description: Represents an individual client connection, managing request/response lifecycle.

methods.name: NewServer
methods.description: Creates a new ttrpc server with optional configurations.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a set of methods under a service name.

methods.name: RegisterService
methods.description: Registers a service description with the server.

methods.name: Serve
methods.description: Starts serving incoming connections on a network listener.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the server, closing idle connections.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Immediately closes the server and all active connections.

methods.name: addListenerLocked
methods.description: Adds a network listener to the server's set of listeners.

methods.name: closeListenerLocked
methods.description: Closes a listener with mutex protection.

methods.name: addConnection
methods.description: Adds a connection to the server's active connection set.

methods.name: delConnection
methods.description: Removes a connection from the active set.

methods.name: countConnection
methods.description: Returns the number of active connections.

methods.name: newConn
methods.description: Creates a new server connection object.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a connection.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the state of a connection.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main loop for processing requests on a server connection.

methods.name: getRequestContext
methods.description: Constructs a context for a request, including timeout and metadata.
